hero_eyebrow: Auto Electrical Specialists — Fast Diagnostics & Repairs

services_heading: Complete Auto Electrical Services in Liverpool
services_subhead: From starter motors to complex hybrid diagnostics, we handle every electrical fault vehicles throw at us.

services.title: Battery Testing & Replacement
services.desc: Rapid battery diagnostics and same-day replacement. We stock premium batteries for all makes and carry out free charging system checks.

services.title: Alternator & Starter Repair
services.desc: Faulty alternator draining your battery? We test, repair, or replace starters and alternators with warrantied parts and labour.

services.title: Fault Code Diagnostics
services.desc: Dashboard warning lights? We run full computer diagnostics to pinpoint electrical and engine faults in minutes, not guesses.

services.title: Wiring & Loom Repair
services.desc: Corroded or damaged wiring causing intermittent faults? We trace, repair, and solder harnesses to original standards.

services.title: Charging System Installation
services.desc: Upgrade your vehicle's electrical capacity. We install quality alternators, auxiliary batteries, and charging upgrades for caravans and work vehicles.

services.title: Lighting & Control Repairs
services.desc: Faulty headlights, dashboard lights, or window regulators. We repair or replace switches, modules, and lighting circuits on the spot.

about_pullquote: I fix what other garages miss — and explain it clearly, so you understand the bill.
about_para_1: John founded Advanced Auto Electrics in 2006 after seeing too many drivers ripped off by vague diagnostic fees and parts bins. He trained as an auto electrician and invested in proper diagnostic kit — the kind that pinpoints real faults instead of guessing. Over 18 years, he's built a reputation for honest work and transparent pricing across Liverpool.
about_para_2: We don't keep customers waiting with unexplained delays. Most diagnostics take under 30 minutes; most repairs happen the same day. Repeat customers come back because they trust that if we say a part needs replacing, it actually does—and that the price is fair.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dead battery and kept getting conflicting advice from other garages. John tested everything properly and saved me £200 by telling me the battery was fine—it was just the alternator. Fixed it that afternoon. Honest mechanic, rare these days.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Dashboard was lighting up like a Christmas tree. Took it to John and he plugged in the diagnostic kit, found a dodgy earth wire on the engine block, sorted it in an hour. Really knew what he was doing and didn't overcharge.
reviews.author: Claire K.

reviews.text: My van's charging system packed in mid-week. John came out, diagnosed it properly, fitted a new alternator and battery by end of day. The job was expensive but fair, and he explained exactly why. Been back three times since.
reviews.author: Paul S.
